name: Explicit Lookup Table Replacement
description: Replaced the 3D phase vectors and their dot products with an explicit 3x3 lookup table of the resulting interference values. This removes the vector math that might trigger pattern-matching to known reductions, forcing the model to independently deduce that achieving a sum of -3m from values in {-3, 6} requires every link to evaluate to -3, and thus every linked pair to have distinct modes.
